explanation: An ancient city in Canaan that the Israelites conquered under Joshua's leadership.
Israel's leader after Moses, who led the Israelites into the promised land.
A divine messenger who gives instructions and guidance from God.
Musical instruments used by the priests to signal God's presence and power.
Circular movements around Jericho performed by the Israelites as part of the siege.
Structures surrounding and protecting the city of Jericho, which eventually collapsed during the attack.
A woman from Jericho who helped the Israelites and was spared because of her faithfulness to God.
